metadataReview.note: Add the site of Argive Hysiae. Thucydides (5.83) records that the Lacedaemonians under Agis captured the Argive town of Hysiae and killed the freemen they took; Pleiades identifies the citadel south of Achladokampos and dates its destruction to 417 BC, consistent with the stored astronomical year −416. The date is retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: Pleiades place 570306 (Hysiai, the Argive frontier citadel south of modern Achladokampos) has one representative location, the OSM location of Hysiai, at [22.5862423,37.5200016] with accuracy value 20 m and certain association; the place reprPoint is identical. Rounded to [22.5862,37.52]. This is a site reference for the captured citadel, not a surveyed Spartan position. Pleiades 540831, the Boeotian Hysiai near Kriekouki, is a different place and is not used.
